messages:
maria-cs: Heads-up — Acme (tenant: acme-prod) is seeing 403s from the /v1/embeddings endpoint while text generation works. Customer indexing job blocked. Anyone seen this pattern?

linda-csm: They're blocked on a nightly job, can reproduce with their key on our staging. Need a quick triage.

maria-cs: Repro steps I ran locally:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/embeddings \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-acme-XXXX' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"input":"hello world","model":"embed-1"}'
```
Response:
```json
{
  "error": "permission_denied",
  "message": "missing scope: embed.create",
  "code": 403
}
```
But same key against /v1/generate returns 200 and works. Request-Id header: rq_0a1b2c3d. Provisioner reported in metadata: sso-provisioner-v2.1.3.

alex-eng: Thanks. Can you paste the token claims from your local decode (no private keys)? Need to confirm scope names.

maria-cs: Token claims (decoded): scopes: ["generation","rerank"] — embeddings scope missing.

sre-bot: auth-checker: token validation failed for /v1/embeddings — missing required scope 'embed.create'.

samir-auth: Quick hypothesis: our auth layer now requires granular names (chat.generate / embed.create / rerank.run). Older provisioner versions emit legacy names like 'generation'. Chat endpoints still accept 'generation' for backward compatibility; embeddings strictly checks for 'embed.create'. I'll grep provisioner mappings.

samir-auth: Found it — sso-provisioner-v2.1.3 writes legacy scopes when the SSO mapping includes the `legacy_scopes` flag. Repro: run provisioner with a SCIM mapping that doesn't set new scope names -> tokens get ["generation","rerank"].

samir-auth: Short repro steps:
```bash
# simulate mapping import
python tools/provisioner_sim.py --mapping scim-acme.csv --legacy_scopes true
# decode token
jwt decode sk-acme-XXXX -> scopes=[generation,rerank]
```

maria-cs: Customer can't rotate keys automatically from their side today because it's part of a larger deploy. They're asking for a temporary bypass while ops fixes the provisioner.

alex-eng: Two options: 1) Reissue a key for them with correct scopes from admin console (fast), or 2) add a temporary compatibility layer in auth that treats 'generation' as granting 'embed.create' for 24h while we patch provisioner. Option 1 is lower risk.

samir-auth: I can reissue via admin API. Endpoint: POST /admin/keys/reissue {"tenant":"acme-prod","scopes":["embed.create","chat.generate","rerank.run"]} -> returns new key. I'll need a request from CSM to confirm rotation.

linda-csm: I'll request permission from the customer now. If they approve, I'll paste the ticket here and we can reissue.

alex-eng: I'll open a PR for an auth-side compatibility flag in case we hit more tenants (auth#3421). Will default off and gated behind a feature flag.

samir-auth: Provisioning fix: v2.1.4 will map legacy->granular scopes during mapping import and will backfill tokens for tenants with legacy flag set. Pushing to staging in ~2h.

provisioning-bot: deploy-notifier: sso-provisioner v2.1.4 scheduled to staging (mapping fix for scope names).

linda-csm: Customer approved a key rotation. Maria, pls reissue when ready.

maria-cs: Reissued via admin API, new key starts with sk-acme-NEW. Verified locally: embedding call returned 200 and vectors created. Customer confirmed on their side: indexing resumed.

maria-cs: Marking triage -> in progress -> will close after provisioner patch is live. Thank you all. :tada:

alex-eng: PR #3421 opened for compatibility flag; tagging security for review.

samir-auth: I'll follow up with provisioning team to backfill and schedule a rolling patch. ETA 48h for rollout + backfill.

maria-cs: Closing loop: rotation + patch planned; customer unblocked. Reopen if any regression. Thanks team! :thumbsup:
